features.text: Ensures precise compatibility with all Rebound Ankle Brace sizes S, M, and L

features.label: Ankle sprain support
features.text: Optimizes brace fit for grade 1 to 3 sprains and chronic instability

features.label: Easy installation
features.text: Simple setup with no special tools required

measurement: Both kits are universal and compatible with all Ossur Rebound Ankle Brace sizes (S, M, L). For the Width Extender Kit, insert into slot 1 for XL calves, slot 2 for 2XL calves, or slot 3 for 3XL calves. Confirm your brace model is the Ossur Rebound Ankle Brace before ordering. For personalized sizing assistance, take advantage of our Perfect Fit Guarantee .
